result.changelog: Overview: the manga line "That's impossible!! Because... You're about to die!" is now credited to Ridley, said to young Samus at K-2L (it was wrongly given to Samus). Ceres removed from the places she beat him. Added the manga detail that Ridley struck down Gray Voice (checked on Metroid Wiki). Removed the unsourced claim that Adam called Ridley as grave a threat as the Metroids. Replaced "vain" with "proud". Rewrote the "every defeat undone" sentence. Added the Pirate Data line that he would relish security work. Reworded the "Zero Mission website" mention so no game title appears in prose. Dropped the keys "the dragon", "Pirate commander" and "Space Pirate commander", and added "geoform-187" and "Ridley's Lair". History entry: removed the invented "at least eight" count and the "Science Team" attribution. Fixed Ceres to say he fled. Added a Gray Voice bullet and a line that he is absent from Prime 4: Beyond (checked on the Metroid Wiki Beyond page). The clone's killer is now "apparently the Queen Metroid". Cut game titles to two. Changed keys to match the reviewer's coverage list. Meta/Omega: Orpheon now cited to the wiki and the rest to the Pirate Data log text, re-read on omegametroid.com, including the "relish" quote. Omega's wound cause, the transport of his remains and the Leviathan compelling him are now softened. Added the Norion details (attack on the Marine platoon, chase through cramped passages). Dropped the "Phazite armor" key. Proteus: removed "regrowing flesh" and the claim that the X came out of the limb. Fight details checked on the Metroid Wiki and Wikipedia Samus Returns pages. Dropped the "Ridley's claw" key. Clone: Adam's "Samus. Follow it!" confirmed on the Metroid Wiki Ridley page and kept with context. MB posing as Madeline is now named as the source of the cloning explanation. Queen Metroid is hedged and the Sector Zero placement removed. Mystery Creature description trimmed to the wiki's wording. Lyle detail added. Clone now driven off badly hurt. Neo-Ridley: removed the wrong "third time" and "first time not Ridley" tallies and the "only incarnation" claim. Weakness wording rewritten in-universe. Dropped the "Ridley's body" key. Mecha Ridley: escape craft generalized. Changed "ending Pirate rule" to "for the time being". Added a line that this Mother Ship brought Ridley to Zebes. Changed "killed in Norfair" to "destroyed in his lair" so it is not confused with his final death. Removed a duplicate key and the "mechanical Ridley" key. Appearance: removed "slit eyes" and the clone's flight timing. The undamageable tail is now credited to the X copy. Corpse-eating is framed as Ridley's own claim. Added that his mouth is vulnerable while he fires. Added keys for beak, scream, roar and size. All entries checked: no forbidden words, at most two game titles each, no forbidden bare keys, no duplicate keys, titles unique. Word counts 229-463; the overview (463) and history (448) are over 400, using the allowance for the biggest subjects.
result.unresolved: The manga claim that Ridley ate the colonists' bodies and taunted Samus that her mother was among them is not on Metroid Wiki. Only WebSearch snippets quoting Wikitroid support it, so it is kept as Ridley's claim, labeled "per the manga". In the manga's Zebes fight it is still unconfirmed whether Samus recovered and destroyed Ridley in that same fight, so the entry does not say. The reviewer's "Little Birdie kept as a pet, played dead to lure a scientist" detail was not found on the pages read and was left out. Unchecked this pass, kept from the draft and not flagged by the fact-check: Anthony survived by freezing a Lava Golem, and Ridley's body was the "second specimen alongside Nightmare". Metroid Wiki contradicts itself on who killed the clone (Queen Metroid vs "unknown means"), so the entry hedges.
